uart_tcp.title: EVO Inverter — UART-TCP bridge (esphome-uart-link / ser2net)
uart_tcp.description: For an ESP32 running esphome-uart-link's uart_tcp_server, or any ser2net-style raw serial-to-TCP bridge. The bytes are still real Modbus RTU frames with CRC16 - only the transport changed.

modbus_tcp.title: EVO Inverter — Modbus TCP gateway (native)
modbus_tcp.description: For a device that natively speaks Modbus TCP (e.g. a commercial RS485-to-Ethernet Modbus gateway that repackages frames itself).

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect or read AC Voltage register (4502) — check wiring/host, port, baud rate, framing and slave ID.
